notes.title: Postponement announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, fans who love Yurif:
I'm sorry to tell you this news. Due to our jobs are too busy and complicated, development is not very smooth...
We have always adhered to the principle of live well before creating, so we gave priority to jobs. 
However, without a happy and healthy develope group, it is difficult to have a pleasant game. In order to ensure the quality of the game, we must to slow down the pace of production......
But we are definitely the ones who want to see the completed game, and we also hope that the production members can recover their health and continue to work hard.
Thank you for your support.

Wish you all health and success 　　 Producer阿半

notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
This Demo may still be some bugs but it does not affect the game.
With the update, some performance effects and story of choice may be different, it is not recommended to use the saves of the previous version.
The demo version will continue to be debugged and updated until the end of a complete character line.

This version of the game content:
-Contain Traditional Chinese and English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese will be updated later.
-The game can be played until the third day start.
-Can meet five characters and have the meeting events of each other.
-One of the characters has three dating events.
-Except of teaching battle, may encounter three battles (will not trigger continuously).
-Hang out in the world to see the scenery.
-Being ridiculed by Angel.


If you have any questions, please feel free to leave a message in [url=https://www.facebook.com/yurif.original/] Facebook [/url] to contact us. 

PS.  This announcement is translated by the producer in a low level, the game story is translated by the formal translator.
